Trinetra Image Monitor

⬇ Step 1 — Download & Update Paths

Download the zip, extract it, open monitor.py and update the paths and credentials before copying to Jetson.

Download trinetra_monitor.zip

⚠ Update these values in monitor.py before running

WATCH_FOLDER Absolute path to the folder you want to monitor on Jetson
DB_PATH Absolute path where SQLite queue file will be stored
LOG_PATH Absolute path for the log file
TG_BOT_TOKEN Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather
TG_CHAT_ID Your Telegram chat ID (see Telegram setup below)
SMTP_USER Your Gmail address
SMTP_PASS Gmail App Password (16 chars, not your login password)
EMAIL_TO Recipient email address

Setup on Jetson

1

Install dependencies

pip3 install requests watchdog
2

Copy the extracted script_monitor folder to Jetson

scp -r script_monitor/ nvidia@<JETSON_IP>:/home/nvidia/

The db/ and logs/ folders are already included — no mkdir needed.

3

Install the systemd service (SSH into Jetson first)

sudo cp /home/nvidia/script_monitor/monitor.service /etc/systemd/system/trinetra-monitor.service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable trinetra-monitor
sudo systemctl start trinetra-monitor
4

Verify it is running

sudo systemctl status trinetra-monitor
5

Test — drop an image into the watch folder

cp any_image.jpg /home/nvidia/detected_frames/

You should receive a Telegram message within seconds.

Service Management

# Check status
sudo systemctl status trinetra-monitor

# Stop
sudo systemctl stop trinetra-monitor

# Restart
sudo systemctl restart trinetra-monitor

# Live logs
journalctl -u trinetra-monitor -f

Config Reference

VariableDescription
WATCH_FOLDERFolder to monitor for new images
ENABLE_TELEGRAMToggle Telegram notifications
ENABLE_EMAILToggle Email notifications
ENABLE_WHATSAPPToggle WhatsApp notifications
TG_BOT_TOKENTelegram bot token from @BotFather
TG_CHAT_IDYour Telegram user/chat ID
SMTP_USERGmail address
SMTP_PASSGmail App Password (16 chars)
EMAIL_TORecipient email address
MAX_ATTEMPTSRetry limit before job is parked in dead_letter table
RETRY_INTERVAL_SECSeconds between offline retry sweeps
DEDUP_WINDOW_SECWindow (seconds) to suppress duplicate events for same file
SETTLE_SECInterval to check file size stability before enqueuing

File Structure on Jetson

/home/nvidia/script_monitor/
├── monitor.py          # main script
├── monitor.service     # systemd service file
├── README.md           # quick reference
├── db/
│   └── queue.db        # SQLite queue (auto-created on first run)
└── logs/
    └── notifier.log    # log file (auto-created on first run)
